en: This is a black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a city with a river running through its center. Several bridges cross the river, and historical buildings line both banks. In the foreground, trees and rooftops are visible. There is a church with a distinctive onion dome and a tower in the foreground. The caption at the bottom is in German and reads: 'Graz. Blick vom Schloßberg gegen Süden.'
